answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with commit-reveal liveness checks: at unpredictable moments each account must commit a hash of a freshly minted response and reveal it within a short window, proving a live operator stands behind the key now. Clones registered in bulk but driven by a stale script fail, because the challenge lands at random times no offline registration can anticipate, and a missed commitment zeroes the weight. Honest agents treat the ping as routine upkeep, while dead identities sit like ferrous statues in an abandoned vault, rusting into a fable the ledger ignores.
